ios.desc:
SensaMarket (formerly UpLeg)

Trading can be complex, but SensaMarket simplifies it with powerful tools and pre-built strategies to help you make informed investment decisions. Our intuitive app features a simple user interface and a robust options builder, offering precise control over various key attributes.
Whether you're a novice or experienced trader, SensaMarket provides an array of features to support your trading journey:

Why SensaMarket is the Right Choice:

-User-Friendly Interface: Navigate the platform effortlessly with our clean and simple UI. Switch between past, present, and future strategies in your Wishlist, and explore pre-built strategies with just a few taps.

-Over 100 Pre-Built Options Trading Strategies: Access a diverse range of strategies, powered by real-time brokerage data. Whether you're looking for bullish, bearish, neutral, or volatile strategies, we've got you covered.

-Start Small, Grow Big: Begin your options trading journey with as little as $1. Invest in stocks, ETFs, and more at your own pace, all commission-free.

-Share & Collaborate: Easily share your trading strategies through Skype, Slack, or WhatsApp. Get advice on-the-go and refine your strategies with input from others.

-Comprehensive Watchlist & Strategy Tracking: Add chosen strategies to your Watchlist, monitor their performance, and execute timely trades. Get a quick overview of your holdings with detailed insights.

-Advanced Options Builder: Construct and customize options trades by specifying various parameters like the underlying asset, expiration date, and strike price. See how these factors affect potential rewards and risks.

-Powerful Real-Time Visualization: Visualize your investments and analyze the impact of your strategies in real-time. Our sophisticated data visualization tools provide detailed graphs and tables, helping you understand the profit and loss potential of your investments.

-Three Simple Steps to Smart Trading:
1. Pick from over 100 pre-built strategies.
2. Select a company holding and visualize the Profit & Loss.
3. Execute your trade!
